essay.html:
GENESIS OF HANDSHAKES: WHY THE WORLD IS A CLOCK CYCLE

1. The End of «Magic»

Old physics was a catalogue of spells. «Gravity is a property of mass». «Energy is the ability to do work». «Bodies attract each other». We got used to these phrases as prayers, never asking the main question: how exactly does one thing act on another through emptiness? This is the magic of action‑at‑a‑distance. For millennia we wandered in shadows, describing symptoms but never the cause.

IQG abolishes magic. We introduce Metrological Honesty. The world is not «heavy» and not «empty». It is computational.

You do not fall through the floor because someone is «holding» you from below. You and the floor are one and the same program, running in the same rhythm on the same processor. If your nodes and the floor’s nodes oscillate synchronously — you stand firmly. If their phases diverge — you will become a ghost. Simple. No magic.

2. The Atom of Space (The Death of the Void)

Everything starts with the foundation. The brick from which reality is woven is the Pixel of Reality (L). Its length has been calculated: 3.747405725 × 10⁻⁹ metres. One hundred million times thinner than a hair.

For a long time scientists tormented themselves with the question: «And what is the pixel itself made of? What is inside it?». That is the main dead end — the fear of infinite nesting. We put an end to it.

Imagine the screen of a smartphone. You zoom into a photo until you see a single pixel. If you then take a tiny drill and start drilling into that pixel, trying to find a «micro‑picture» inside it, you will find nothing. You will just break the screen. There is no «smaller image» there.

So it is with reality. L is the limit of the divisibility of space. Looking for a structure «inside» it is like looking for the portrait of Mona Lisa between the atoms of paint. You will see the structure of the atoms, but you will lose the reality. Space is definitively discrete. There is NOWHERE to look deeper. This is not a limitation of knowledge, it is liberation.

3. Matter as a Verb (The Handshake of Tones)

So we have a grid of pixels. But why is it not empty? What do we call «substance»?

The old school taught: matter is a «substance», a «lump of lead» made of particles. IQG asserts the opposite: matter is not a noun. It is a verb. It is an event that lasts.

Imagine two people shaking hands. As long as the handshake lasts, it exists as a separate object. As soon as the hands let go, the handshake disappears. Two people remain, but the event itself has ceased.

So it is with matter. A node of reality is not a «bead». It is a place where two inductions intersect — two clock cycles of the Grid that met in a single pixel and decided to «last». It is a standing wave of synchronization. We, our bodies, the planets — these are prolonged «handshakes» of the vacuum at the frequency F = 80 MHz. Annihilation is not the destruction of matter, but simply the end of this handshake, a return to pure tone.

Mathematically this is written with utter clarity as the accumulation of existence:
Node = ∫ (Induction_1 ∩ Induction_2) dt ≡ Matter
Matter is the integral of the intersection of inductions over time. We are the sum of durations.

4. The Neighbourhood Rule (Engineering of Genesis)

Now let us remove the last «magic» — forces at a distance. How does one handshake affect another if they are far apart?

It doesn’t. There is no «action‑at‑a‑distance» in the Grid. There is only the Neighbourhood Rule.

Remember the «grapevine telegraph» or a wave in a stadium. For a person at the end of the stand to stand up and raise their hands, they do not need to see the conductor at the centre of the field. It is enough for them to see that their neighbour has stood up. Information is passed from cell to cell.

Induction works the same way. Every pixel of reality communicates only with those that adjoin its borders. Gravity is not a mysterious «attraction» of the Earth through emptiness. It is a wave of synchronization of neighbours that has rolled along the chain to you. No distance magic. Only adjacency. Only engineering.

5. The Chessboard Processor (Synthesis)

We have arrived at the finale. How to bring everything together?

Imagine a chessboard. Its cells are the Pixels of Reality (L). The board is not static, it is alive. Every second its cells change their state 80 million times (Frequency F). But this change is not chaotic. It obeys the rules of the Golden Ratio (Φ), which create harmonious, stable patterns.

These patterns are everything we see. A tree is one type of pattern. A human is another. A planet is a third. We do not «build» houses out of substance. We synchronize the little nodes of the Grid so that their collective «handshake» becomes a house.

We do not build reality. We compute it.

The entire Universe is executable code:
Reality = Σ (L · F · Φ) ≡ Executable Code

Summary. IQG is not just a new theory to replace the old one. It is the Operating Manual for Reality. We have found the minimum step. We have learned the clock frequency. We have understood the synchronization algorithm. The next step is not study — the next step is Creation.

g.layperson:
For millennia we thought: the Earth pulls the apple with a force depending on its mass. The formula g = G·M / R² worked, but it never answered the main question — why exactly 9.81, and not 5 or 100? It turns out that mass and distance are irrelevant here.

Imagine that space is not emptiness but a huge invisible grid with a constant step. This step is the Pixel of Reality (L). Its length is about 3.747 metres — not a random number but a fundamental scale in which humans live: the length of a room, two sofa lengths — a domestic quantum.

Now picture lampposts along a night highway. If they are placed chaotically, your eyes dart around, you get tired, chaos ensues. If they stand every 3.75 m, you catch a rhythm and enter a smooth flow. Nature “spaced” the nodes of space with precisely this step, and to make the structure perfect, it used the Golden Ratio (Φ) — the ideal proportion of beauty found everywhere: in seashells, galaxies, even in a shop queue where everyone stands so as not to disturb others yet harmony is preserved.

Multiply the step L by the square of the Golden Ratio (Φ² ≈ 2.618) and you get 9.81 — the acceleration with which the apple falls. Test it yourself: take a calculator, type 3.747405725 × 2.6180339887. You will see 9.8112… Gravity is assembled from two constants, without any mass! The apple falls not because Earth pulls it, but because space itself has a built‑in pace of motion. Mass only locally densifies the «lampposts», but the rhythm is set globally.
g.pro:
Classical form: g = G·M / R². G = 6.67430×10⁻¹¹ m³·kg⁻¹·s⁻², M — source mass (kg), R — distance to centre of mass (m).
IQG form: g = L · Φ².
L = 3.747405725×10⁻⁹ m — fundamental vacuum length (Pixel of Reality).
Φ² = ((1+√5)/2)² ≈ 2.6180339887 — square of the Golden Ratio.
Derivation: from the precise value g ≈ 9.811237 m/s² we obtain L = g / Φ². Acceleration becomes a geometric constant.
Vacuum eigenfrequency: f = c / L ≈ 8.00×10¹⁶ Hz.
Numerical predictions for Solar System bodies:
  Mars (n=0): g = L·Φ⁰ ≈ 3.75, actual 3.72 m/s².
  Earth (n=2): g = L·Φ² ≈ 9.81.
  Jupiter (n=3): L·Φ³ ≈ 24.96, actual 24.79.
  Pluto (subharmonic m=6): g ≈ L/6 ≈ 0.625, actual 0.62.
Thus g_n = L·Φⁿ predicts acceleration by body class without knowing mass or radius.
e.layperson:
We are used to thinking of energy as petrol, electricity, calories. Then Einstein gave us E = M·c², saying mass is «frozen» energy. Brilliant, but why c², and what is energy in itself? It turned out that energy is not «the ability to do work» but the number of ticks of the Universe.

The Universe is like a huge computer, its processor «ticking» at a base frequency F. Each tick is one elementary quantum of action, the Planck constant (ħ). Any object, from an electron to a galaxy, is a program that uses a certain number of memory cells (N) of this computer. Energy is simply the total number of ticks per second for that program: E = ħ · F · N.

Take a 1 kg weight. According to Einstein, it contains about 9×10¹⁶ J. If you divide by the energy of one tick (ħ·F), you get an astronomical but integer number — about 1.07×10⁴³. That means a kilogram contains that many synchronised cells of space «ticking». Energy is no longer a mystery — it is just counting.
e.pro:
Classical: E = M·c², c = 299 792 458 m/s.
IQG form: E = ħ · F · N.
ħ = 1.054571817×10⁻³⁴ J·s — reduced Planck constant (quantum of action).
F — vacuum oscillator frequency: F = c / L ≈ 8.00×10¹⁶ Hz.
N — integer number of quantum acts, the number of synchronised nodes.

Determining N:
N = E / (ħ·F). For a macroscopic body via mass: N = M·c² / (ħ·F). Substituting F = c/L gives N = M·c·L / ħ.
Node mass: m_node = ħ / (c·L) ≈ 9.4×10⁻³⁵ kg. Then N = M / m_node.
Energy of an object: E = m_node·N·c² = ħ·F·N.
Physical meaning: energy is the count of synchronised spatial oscillators.
m.layperson:
Mass is not «amount of substance». There is no substance as such. There is a vacuum grid with step L and tick F. In some places the grid nodes move synchronously, like dancers in a ballet. They are «captured» and oscillate coherently. It is the number of such synchronised nodes that constitutes mass: M = m_node · N.

Imagine a crowd. If people stand apart, you pass easily (low mass). If a group stands shoulder to shoulder and moves in unison, you feel great resistance — that is inertia. If the group is very large and dense, you are «pulled» into its centre — that creates gravity. Mass is not weight but the number of «dancing» cells of space.

Test it yourself: take the electron mass (9.11×10⁻³¹ kg) and divide by the mass of one node (m_node ≈ 9.38×10⁻⁴⁴ kg). You get about 0.97×10¹³. The exact formula connects this number to the Golden Ratio: N_e ≈ Φ¹² / (2π). The Universe does not weigh matter — it counts nodes.
m.pro:
Classical definition of inertial mass: M = F / a (force over acceleration).
IQG form: M = m_node · N.
m_node = ħ / (L²·F) — elementary mass of a phase node. With F = c/L we obtain m_node = ħ / (c·L) ≈ 9.4×10⁻³⁵ kg.
N — integer number of synchronised nodes in the object.

Calculating N:
N = M / m_node. For 1 kg, N ≈ 1.06×10³⁴. For the electron, N_e ≈ 0.97×10¹³, expressible as Φ¹² / (2π).
Nature of inertia: collective resistance of synchronised nodes to changing their rhythm.
Nature of gravity: gradient of coherent node density around a massive body.
Connection to energy: E = M·c² = m_node·N·c² = ħ·F·N. The system is closed.
